messages.content: Help me create a MethodEntryRequest for a specific thread `mainThread`, class `com.example.MainClass`, with a suspend policy of `EventRequest.SUSPEND_ALL`, and a custom property `testProperty` in a JDI test environment?

function.name: filter_s002_setting22MethodEntryRequest
function.description: Sets up a MethodEntryRequest with specified thread filter, class filter, suspend policy, and custom property. Throws JDITestRuntimeException on failure. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

thread.description: The ThreadReference to which the request will be applied. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

testedClass.description: The name of the class to filter for method entries. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

suspendPolicy.description: The suspend policy to be used for this request. This is Java integer type parameter in string representation.

property.description: A custom property to associate with this request. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

message.content:
Below is the exact call you’ll need to make in your JDI‑test harness.  
It uses the helper you have in the `functions` namespace to wire up a **MethodEntryRequest** that:

| Parameter | Value | Meaning |
|-----------|-------|---------|
| `thread` | `"mainThread"` | The thread you want the request to apply to. |
| `testedClass` | `"com.example.MainClass"` | Only method entries in this class will trigger the event. |
| `suspendPolicy` | `"EventRequest.SUSPEND_ALL"` | All threads will be suspended when the event fires. |
| `property` | `"testProperty"` | A custom key/value you can later retrieve from the event. |

```java
// Invoke the helper that sets up the MethodEntryRequest
functions.filter_s002_setting22MethodEntryRequest({
    thread: "mainThread",
    testedClass: "com.example.MainClass",
    suspendPolicy: "EventRequest.SUSPEND_ALL",
    property: "testProperty"
});
```

**What happens under the hood**

* The helper creates a `MethodEntryRequest` on the supplied `ThreadReference` (`mainThread`).  
* It attaches a class filter so only methods declared in `com.example.MainClass` will fire.  
* The request uses the `EventRequest.SUSPEND_ALL` policy, meaning *all* threads will be suspended when the event is delivered.  
* The custom property (`testProperty`) is stored in the request’s `properties` map, so you can later inspect it via `event.request().property("testProperty")`.

**Error handling**

If anything goes wrong (e.g., the thread isn’t found, the class can’t be loaded, or the request can’t be created), the helper throws a `JDITestRuntimeException`. Wrap the call in a try/catch if you need to handle that case explicitly.

That’s all you need—just drop the snippet into your test setup and you’ll have a fully‑configured MethodEntryRequest ready to go.
